name: GA Cubers Go Bananas 2024
information: This competition has odd events and not the normal 3x3x3 Speedsolving event. In addition, this competiton will hold the unofficial events of **Banana Cube**, **FTO**, and **Mirror Blocks**. More info about this can be found in the Unofficial Events tab. We recommend Parking at the Student Center Parking located at 353 Ferst Dr NW, Atlanta, GA 30332. Parking is $2/hr up to a flat $15/day fee.
